name: York and Lancaster Counties Habitat Improvement Grant
summary: Annual mitigation money for stream habitat improvement, sediment reduction, agricultural best management practices and small dam removals in York and Lancaster Counties, Pennsylvania.

eligibility.rule: Project improves habitat, reduces sediment, or does both
Applicant is an eligible public body or organisation, excluding individuals and for-profit firms
NGO bylaws include habitat, open-space, watershed or natural-area conservation for public benefit
NGOs are incorporated with the Pennsylvania Department of State
NGOs requesting $5,000 or more are registered with Pennsylvania’s Bureau of Charitable Organizations
NGOs have existed for at least five consecutive years

pool.quote: PFBC receives a combined total of $150,000 annually to fund projects such as dam removals

co_finance_required.quote: Applicants are encouraged to secure matching funds in the form of grants from other institutions, cash, in-kind labor, equipment, materials and supplies.

effort.quote: Project applications must be postmarked no later than February 19, 2027.
Applications will be reviewed for applicant eligibility and completeness.

eligibility.quote: To be eligible, projects must be located in York or Lancaster County and be a habitat improvement and/or a sediment reduction project.
Ineligible applicants include individuals, private for-profit firms and others that do not fall within the eligibility categories.

The organization’s bylaws must indicate that its charitable purpose includes the preservation or conservation of critical habitat, open space, watersheds, rivers and streams, or natural areas for public benefit.
The organization must be incorporated with the Pennsylvania Department of State, Bureau of Corporations
The organization must be tax-exempt under Section 501 (c)(3) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986.
The organization must be registered with the Pennsylvania Department of State, Bureau of Charitable Organizations. This requirement will be waived for grant requests of less than $5,000.
The organization must be in existence for at least 5 consecutive years.

after_award.quote: GRANTEE shall submit a final report to the PFBC upon the project completion.
